round3.finding: checkpoint 13 read /proc/<pid>/environ and cmdline with `tr '\0' '\n' <file | grep -m1` under set -o pipefail; grep exiting on its match before tr finished writing a large environment killed tr with SIGPIPE, the pipeline reported 141, and `if entry="$(…)"` read the hit as a miss. Five sites (LEGION-6's pane environ+cmdline loop, this PR's server cmdline loop, server secret loop, and OMP_SESSION_ID NOTE probe).
round3.fix: proc_entry() { grep -z -m1 -- "^${name}=" /proc/<pid>/<file> | tr -d '\0'; } — grep reads the file and is the only early-exiting process; tr is downstream draining a closed pipe, so no writer is ever killed. Applied at all five sites. Also: the server-secret failure message drops the `expected only ${name}_FILE` clause (server must carry neither; reviewer fast-follow item 1) and the show-environment -g regex is built from the names array.
